symptomShortText: Bore misalignment reported at customer assembly

defect.defectText: Bore position out of true position

causesIshikawa.description: EMP-9022, Shift B - loaded parts per the fixture instruction
EQ-MILL11-002 ballbar test 0.012mm circularity, within the 0.02mm limit
DOC-11260 Rev B - machining sequence and fixture unchanged
Casting lot CST-7701 dimensional and hardness cert PASS

CMM program CMM-BC14-03 was rebuilt on 2026-07-15 and references datum B on the as-cast face instead of the machined face called out on the drawing; every part since then measured in-tolerance against the wrong datum
20.4C in the metrology room, within the 20 +/-1C requirement

fiveWhyChain.question: Why is the bore out of true position at the customer?
fiveWhyChain.answer: True position measured 0.19mm against a 0.08mm maximum when checked against the drawing datum

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did these parts pass our own inspection?
fiveWhyChain.answer: CMM program CMM-BC14-03 measures from the as-cast face rather than the machined datum B, understating true position by roughly 0.11mm

fiveWhyChain.question: Why was a CMM program with the wrong datum released? (root cause)
fiveWhyChain.answer: The program was rebuilt and put into service without a first-article correlation against the drawing datum scheme or a second-person review

actions.actionText: Freeze CMM-BC14-03 and re-measure all BC14 stock against the drawing datum on a manual setup
Sort the 156 units at the customer and replace any part outside true position
Rebuild CMM-BC14-03 against datum B and correlate against a first article before release

lessonsLearned.whatWorked: The customer report and our own records disagreeing pointed straight at the measurement system rather than the process
lessonsLearned.whatDidnt: A measurement program could be rebuilt and released with nobody checking it against the drawing

isIsNot.isWhereWhenItHappens: BC14 measured with CMM program CMM-BC14-03 after its 2026-07-15 rebuild
isIsNot.isNotWhereWhenItDoesnt: BC14 measured before 07-15, and BC12 measured with its own unmodified program on the same CMM
isIsNot.notes: Defect follows the measurement program, not the machine or the casting lot
